stages.title: Recruiter screen
turns: dana
Dana Okafor (recruiter, Halden Robotics): Thanks for joining, Tomás. What made you apply?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): I lead safety certification for robotic cells at Ostrava Motion. I want to move closer to motion control itself.
dana
Dana Okafor (recruiter, Halden Robotics): What base salary are you targeting?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): A base salary of $170,000 would work for me.
dana
Dana Okafor (recruiter, Halden Robotics): And your notice period?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): Four weeks. I could start on November 2.
dana
Dana Okafor (recruiter, Halden Robotics): The role is based in Pittsburgh. Where are you now?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): Cleveland. I would relocate to Pittsburgh if relocation support is included.
stages.scorecard: Yes from the screen. Leads safety certification today and wants to move into motion control. Base expectation $170k, notice four weeks (earliest start November 2), would relocate from Cleveland with relocation support.

stages.title: Technical interview
turns: marcus
Marcus Lee (hiring manager, Halden Robotics): Have you certified safety-rated motion functions yourself?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): Yes. I have signed off three PL d safety functions, including safe speed monitoring on a palletising cell.
marcus
Marcus Lee (hiring manager, Halden Robotics): How much loop design have you done?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): Less. I tune existing loops with the vendor tools, but I have not designed a cascaded loop from the plant model.
stages.scorecard: Lean yes. Deep, hands-on safety certification (three PL d functions signed off). Concern: little control-loop design from first principles; would need a strong pairing partner on the motion stack.

stages.title: Values interview
turns: aiko
Aiko Sato (values interviewer, Halden Robotics): Tell me about a time you pushed back on a deadline.
tomas

Tomás Ferreira (candidate): A customer wanted a cell commissioned before the safety validation was done. I refused to sign, explained the liability, and we shipped a week later with the validation complete.
aiko
Aiko Sato (values interviewer, Halden Robotics): How do you share what you know?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): I run a monthly safety clinic for the commissioning engineers.
stages.scorecard: Yes. Holds the line on safety under customer pressure and teaches it to others.

withdraw.reason: Tomás withdrew from the process on 2026-10-02: he accepted another offer and asked us to stop using his information for this opening.

reapply.title: Re-engagement call
turns: eli
Eli Brandt (recruiter, Halden Robotics): Tomás, thanks for reaching out again. You applied for the new Controls Engineer, Safety Systems opening.
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): Yes. The other company froze the team I joined, so I am looking again. This opening fits my safety background better anyway.
eli
Eli Brandt (recruiter, Halden Robotics): Has anything changed on compensation or start date?
tomas
Tomás Ferreira (candidate): My base expectation is now $178,000, and I could start within two weeks.
reapply.scorecard: Re-engaged for Controls Engineer, Safety Systems. Base expectation now $178k (was $170k in September); can start within two weeks. September interview feedback still applies.
